settings.text:
Private access inside the Great Pyramid and Paws of the Sphinx – Meditate in the King’s Chamber during a rare and powerful private ceremony.

Visit the Grand Egyptian Museum through William’s trained eye.

Luxor & Karnak Temples – Decode the language of light and sound etched into every wall.

Temple of Horus at Edfu – Uncover the Starwalker legacy and the blueprint of resurrection.

Sailing the Nile – Drift down the river of eternity on the exclusive  Sanctuary Sun Boat III, surrounded by desert, sky, and stars.

Sacred Teachings – Daily mystical teaching and amazing historical presentations from William Henry.

Conscious Community – Travel with a group of like-minded seekers devoted to truth, healing, and cosmic remembrance.

After transferring to the Sun Boat III, we will enjoy a visit to the Luxor Temple. The SB III is a truly spoiling experience - listed as one of Condé Nast’s Top 100 most beautiful boats in the world. You will experience the ultimate in service, superb food, delightful staff, and exquisite amenities. Breakfast, lunch & dinner included.
